"""Real disposable Git/journal repeat probe; never changes the canonical house."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import platform
import sys

from house.home_work import git
from house.integrate import integrate
from tests.test_integrate import IntegrationTests


case = IntegrationTests()
case.setUp()
workspace = case.candidate("repeat", "first\n")
report_path = case.private / "repeat" / "contribution.json"
report = json.loads(report_path.read_text())
git(case.repo, "fetch", "--quiet", str(workspace), report["commit"])
git(case.repo, "merge", "--ff-only", report["commit"])
accepted_head = git(case.repo, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
receipt_path = case.private / "repeat" / "integration.json"
accepted = {
    "run": "repeat", "actor": "alice", "base": case.base,
    "contribution": report["commit"], "candidate": "integration-seeded",
    "candidate_head": accepted_head, "status": "integrated", "test_exit": 0,
}
output = {
    "platform": platform.platform(), "python": sys.version,
    "source_root": str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent),
    "fixture": str(case.repo),
    "acceptance_origin": "synthetic receipt, real contribution fast-forward; test_exit=0 is fixture data, not an executed first acceptance",
    "source_commit": git(Path.cwd(), "rev-parse", "HEAD"),
    "source_integrate_sha256": hashlib.sha256(Path("house/integrate.py").read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    "checks": [],
}

for publish in (False, True):
    receipt_path.write_text(json.dumps(accepted, indent=2) + "\n")
    receipt_path.chmod(0o600)
    before = receipt_path.read_bytes()
    journal_before = case.record.read()[2]
    entry = {"publish": publish, "before": accepted}
    try:
        entry["returned"] = integrate(case.record, "repeat", "alice", publish=publish)
    except Exception as error:
        entry["error"] = {"type": type(error).__name__, "text": str(error)}
    entry["after"] = json.loads(receipt_path.read_text())
    entry["receipt_bytes_preserved"] = receipt_path.read_bytes() == before
    entry["journal_preserved"] = case.record.read()[2] == journal_before
    entry["source_head_preserved"] = git(case.repo, "rev-parse", "HEAD") == accepted_head
    entry["source_clean"] = not git(case.repo, "status", "--porcelain", "--untracked-files=all")
    entry["document_preserved"] = (case.repo / "document.txt").read_text() == "first\n"
    logs = sorted(case.private.glob("integration-*.tests.log"))
    entry["test_logs"] = {p.name: p.read_text() for p in logs}
    output["checks"].append(entry)

receipt_path.write_text(json.dumps(accepted, indent=2) + "\n")
case.record.append("wake", "author-repeat", {})
before = receipt_path.read_bytes()
try:
    integrate(case.record, "repeat", "author-repeat", publish=True)
    output["self_review"] = {"rejected": False}
except ValueError as error:
    output["self_review"] = {"rejected": True, "error": str(error)}
output["self_review"]["receipt_preserved"] = receipt_path.read_bytes() == before

report_path.write_text(json.dumps({**report, "base": "0" * 40}) + "\n")
try:
    integrate(case.record, "repeat", "alice")
    output["changed_identity"] = {"rejected": False}
except ValueError as error:
    output["changed_identity"] = {"rejected": True, "error": str(error)}
output["changed_identity"]["receipt_preserved"] = receipt_path.read_bytes() == before
Path(sys.argv[1]).write_text(json.dumps(output, indent=2) + "\n")
print(json.dumps(output, indent=2))
case.doCleanups()

import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys

from house.home_work import git
from tests.test_integrate import IntegrationTests

module_path = Path(sys.argv[1])
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("house.mallow_candidate", module_path)
module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(module)
integrate = module.integrate
case = IntegrationTests()
case.setUp()
workspace = case.candidate("repeat", "first\n")
report_path = case.private / "repeat/contribution.json"
report = json.loads(report_path.read_text())
git(case.repo, "fetch", "--quiet", str(workspace), report["commit"])
git(case.repo, "merge", "--ff-only", report["commit"])
head = git(case.repo, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
receipt_path = case.private / "repeat/integration.json"
accepted = {"run": "repeat", "actor": "alice", "base": case.base,
            "contribution": report["commit"], "candidate": "integration-seeded",
            "candidate_head": head, "status": "integrated", "test_exit": 0}
results = []

def observe(label, value, actor="bob", publish=False, rejected=None):
    receipt_path.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2) + "\n")
    receipt_path.chmod(0o600)
    before = receipt_path.read_bytes()
    journal = case.record.read()[2]
    candidates = sorted(str(p) for p in case.private.glob("integration-*"))
    source = git(case.repo, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
    document = (case.repo / "document.txt").read_bytes()
    entry = {"case": label, "actor": actor, "publish": publish}
    try:
        returned = integrate(case.record, "repeat", actor, publish=publish)
        entry["returned_equal"] = returned == value
        entry["passed"] = rejected is None and returned == value
    except ValueError as error:
        entry["error"] = str(error)
        entry["passed"] = rejected is not None and rejected in str(error)
    entry.update(receipt_preserved=receipt_path.read_bytes() == before,
                 journal_preserved=case.record.read()[2] == journal,
                 candidates_preserved=sorted(str(p) for p in case.private.glob("integration-*")) == candidates,
                 source_head_preserved=git(case.repo, "rev-parse", "HEAD") == source,
                 document_preserved=(case.repo / "document.txt").read_bytes() == document)
    entry["passed"] &= all(entry[key] for key in ("receipt_preserved", "journal_preserved",
                          "candidates_preserved", "source_head_preserved", "document_preserved"))
    results.append(entry)

observe("normal dry repeat", accepted)
observe("normal publish repeat", accepted, publish=True)
git(case.repo, "-c", "commit.gpgsign=false", "-c", "user.name=Test", "-c",
    "user.email=test@local", "commit", "--allow-empty", "-m", "Later source")
curated = {"run": "repeat", "actor": "alice", "contribution": report["commit"],
           "canonical_commit": head, "status": "integrated",
           "resolution": "fixture-only.md", "method": "Synthetic exact-artifact acceptance"}
observe("curated format after later source commit", curated)
(case.repo / "document.txt").write_text("uncommitted next task\n")
observe("curated receipt with dirty unrelated source", curated, publish=True)
(case.repo / "document.txt").write_text("first\n")
case.record.append("wake", "author-repeat", {})
observe("self review", accepted, actor="author-repeat", rejected="different, awake")
case.record.append("sleep", "bob", {"through": 0, "note": "Fixture rest"})
observe("sleeping reviewer", accepted, rejected="different, awake")
case.record.append("wake", "bob", {})
observe("unknown reviewer", accepted, actor="stranger", rejected="must be a resident")
report_path.write_text(json.dumps({**report, "base": "0" * 40}))
observe("changed contribution report", accepted, rejected="identity changed")
report_path.write_text(json.dumps(report))
for key, value in (("run", "another"), ("contribution", "0" * 40),
                   ("candidate_head", "0" * 40), ("candidate_head", "--all"),
                   ("candidate_head", case.base),
                   ("canonical_commit", 7), ("canonical_commit", case.base)):
    observe("inconsistent receipt " + key + "=" + str(value), {**accepted, key: value},
            rejected="accepted contribution")
other = case.candidate("other", "second\n")
other_head = git(other, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
git(case.repo, "fetch", "--quiet", str(other), other_head)
observe("anchor exists outside canonical ancestry", {**accepted, "candidate_head": other_head},
        rejected="outside current source history")
git(workspace, "-c", "commit.gpgsign=false", "-c", "user.name=Test", "-c",
    "user.email=test@local", "commit", "--allow-empty", "-m", "Changed contribution")
observe("changed workspace HEAD", accepted, rejected="identity changed")
curated_commit = git(workspace, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
report_path.write_text(json.dumps({**report, "commit": curated_commit}))
git(case.repo, "fetch", "--quiet", str(workspace), curated_commit)
assert subprocess.run(["git", "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", curated_commit,
                       git(case.repo, "rev-parse", "HEAD")], cwd=case.repo,
                      capture_output=True).returncode == 1
assert (workspace / "document.txt").read_bytes() == (case.repo / "document.txt").read_bytes()
observe("curated exact bytes accepted without contribution ancestry",
        {**curated, "contribution": curated_commit})
output = {"module_sha256": hashlib.sha256(module_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
          "acceptance_origin": "synthetic receipts; actual Git contribution and canonical ancestry; no first acceptance or nested tests claimed",
          "checks": results, "passed": all(r["passed"] for r in results)}
Path(sys.argv[2]).write_text(json.dumps(output, indent=2) + "\n")
print(json.dumps(output, indent=2))
case.doCleanups()
sys.exit(0 if output["passed"] else 1)

"""Review private source contributions before a serialized fast-forward publication.

Candidates and failures remain in private Git clones. No reset, stash, forced
update or patch overwrite is used on the shared source checkout.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import fcntl
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import uuid

from .home_work import git
from .record import Record
from . import test_sandbox


def integrate(record: Record, run: str, actor: str, *, publish: bool = False) -> dict:
    if not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,100}", run):
        raise ValueError("invalid run ID")
    private = record.common / "house-home"
    private.mkdir(mode=0o700, exist_ok=True)
    with (private / "integration.lock").open("a+b") as lock:
        fcntl.flock(lock.fileno(), fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
        state, _, _ = record.read()
        item = state.get("life", {}).get("runs", {}).get(run)
        if not item or item["status"] != "completed":
            raise ValueError("contribution requires a stopped resident")
        if actor not in state["residents"]:
            raise ValueError("integrator must be a resident")
        if actor == item["resident"] or not state["residents"][actor]["awake"]:
            raise ValueError("integration requires a different, awake resident")
        workspace = private / "residents" / run
        report = json.loads((private / run / "contribution.json").read_text())
        if report["base"] != item["source_head"] or report["commit"] != git(workspace, "rev-parse", "HEAD"):
            raise ValueError("contribution identity changed")
        head = git(record.root, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
        path = private / run / "integration.json"
        if path.exists():
            accepted = json.loads(path.read_text())
            if accepted.get("status") == "integrated":
                # Both fields exist in durable receipts: normal merges record
                # candidate_head; operator-curated acceptance records canonical_commit.
                anchors = [accepted[key] for key in ("canonical_commit", "candidate_head") if key in accepted]
                if (accepted.get("run") != run or accepted.get("contribution") != report["commit"]
                        or not anchors or any(not isinstance(anchor, str)
                            or not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}", anchor)
                            or anchor != anchors[0] for anchor in anchors)):
                    raise ValueError("accepted contribution receipt is inconsistent; preserve it")
                ancestor = subprocess.run(["git", "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", anchors[0], head],
                                          cwd=record.root, capture_output=True)
                if ancestor.returncode != 0:
                    raise ValueError("accepted contribution is outside current source history; preserve it")
                return accepted
        if git(record.root, "status", "--porcelain", "--untracked-files=all"):
            raise ValueError("shared source has uncommitted work; preserve it")
        candidate = private / ("integration-" + uuid.uuid4().hex)
        subprocess.run(["git", "clone", "--quiet", "--no-local", "--single-branch", "--no-tags",
                        str(record.root), str(candidate)], check=True, capture_output=True)
        git(candidate, "remote", "remove", "origin")
        git(candidate, "fetch", "--quiet", str(workspace), report["commit"])
        receipt = {"run": run, "actor": actor, "base": head, "contribution": report["commit"],
                   "candidate": candidate.name, "status": "conflict"}
        merged = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(candidate), "-c", "commit.gpgsign=false",
                                 "-c", "user.name=Emberhall integrator", "-c", "user.email=house@local",
                                 "merge", "--no-edit", report["commit"]], capture_output=True, text=True)
        (candidate.parent / (candidate.name + ".merge.log")).write_text(merged.stdout + merged.stderr)
        if merged.returncode == 0:
            receipt["candidate_head"] = git(candidate, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
            # A foundation change warrants the existing full acceptance suite.
            # Run only when accepting changed source, never as a wake ritual.
            with (candidate.parent / (candidate.name + ".tests.log")).open("w") as output:
                tested = test_sandbox.run([sys.executable, "-m", "unittest", "discover", "-s", "tests", "-q"],
                                          cwd=candidate, stdout=output, timeout=900)
            unchanged = (git(candidate, "rev-parse", "HEAD") == receipt["candidate_head"] and
                         not git(candidate, "status", "--porcelain", "--untracked-files=all"))
            receipt.update(status="reviewed" if tested.returncode == 0 and unchanged else "tests-failed",
                           test_exit=tested.returncode)
        if publish and receipt["status"] == "reviewed":

"""Review private source contributions before a serialized fast-forward publication.

Candidates and failures remain in private Git clones. No reset, stash, forced
update or patch overwrite is used on the shared source checkout.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import fcntl
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import uuid

from .home_work import git
from .record import Record
from . import test_sandbox


def integrate(record: Record, run: str, actor: str, *, publish: bool = False) -> dict:
    if not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,100}", run):
        raise ValueError("invalid run ID")
    private = record.common / "house-home"
    private.mkdir(mode=0o700, exist_ok=True)
    with (private / "integration.lock").open("a+b") as lock:
        fcntl.flock(lock.fileno(), fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
        state, _, _ = record.read()
        item = state.get("life", {}).get("runs", {}).get(run)
        if not item or item["status"] != "completed":
            raise ValueError("contribution requires a stopped resident")
        if actor not in state["residents"]:
            raise ValueError("integrator must be a resident")
        if actor == item["resident"] or not state["residents"][actor]["awake"]:
            raise ValueError("integration requires a different, awake resident")
        workspace = private / "residents" / run
        report = json.loads((private / run / "contribution.json").read_text())
        if report["base"] != item["source_head"] or report["commit"] != git(workspace, "rev-parse", "HEAD"):
            raise ValueError("contribution identity changed")
        head = git(record.root, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
        path = private / run / "integration.json"
        if path.exists():
            accepted = json.loads(path.read_text())
            if accepted.get("status") == "integrated":
                # Both fields exist in durable receipts: normal merges record
                # candidate_head; operator-curated acceptance records canonical_commit.
                anchors = [accepted[key] for key in ("canonical_commit", "candidate_head") if key in accepted]
                if (accepted.get("run") != run or accepted.get("contribution") != report["commit"]
                        or not anchors or any(not isinstance(anchor, str)
                            or not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}", anchor)
                            or anchor != anchors[0] for anchor in anchors)):
                    raise ValueError("accepted contribution receipt is inconsistent; preserve it")
                ancestor = subprocess.run(["git", "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", anchors[0], head],
                                          cwd=record.root, capture_output=True)
                if ancestor.returncode != 0:
                    raise ValueError("accepted contribution is outside current source history; preserve it")
                if "candidate_head" in accepted:
                    contains = subprocess.run(["git", "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", report["commit"],
                                               accepted["candidate_head"]], cwd=record.root, capture_output=True)
                    if contains.returncode != 0:
                        raise ValueError("accepted contribution is absent from its merge commit; preserve it")
                return accepted
        if git(record.root, "status", "--porcelain", "--untracked-files=all"):
            raise ValueError("shared source has uncommitted work; preserve it")
        candidate = private / ("integration-" + uuid.uuid4().hex)
        subprocess.run(["git", "clone", "--quiet", "--no-local", "--single-branch", "--no-tags",
                        str(record.root), str(candidate)], check=True, capture_output=True)
        git(candidate, "remote", "remove", "origin")
        git(candidate, "fetch", "--quiet", str(workspace), report["commit"])
        receipt = {"run": run, "actor": actor, "base": head, "contribution": report["commit"],
                   "candidate": candidate.name, "status": "conflict"}
        merged = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(candidate), "-c", "commit.gpgsign=false",
                                 "-c", "user.name=Emberhall integrator", "-c", "user.email=house@local",
                                 "merge", "--no-edit", report["commit"]], capture_output=True, text=True)
        (candidate.parent / (candidate.name + ".merge.log")).write_text(merged.stdout + merged.stderr)
        if merged.returncode == 0:
            receipt["candidate_head"] = git(candidate, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
            # A foundation change warrants the existing full acceptance suite.
            # Run only when accepting changed source, never as a wake ritual.
            with (candidate.parent / (candidate.name + ".tests.log")).open("w") as output:
                tested = test_sandbox.run([sys.executable, "-m", "unittest", "discover", "-s", "tests", "-q"],
                                          cwd=candidate, stdout=output, timeout=900)
            unchanged = (git(candidate, "rev-parse", "HEAD") == receipt["candidate_head"] and
                         not git(candidate, "status", "--porcelain", "--untracked-files=all"))
            receipt.update(status="reviewed" if tested.returncode == 0 and unchanged else "tests-failed",
                           test_exit=tested.returncode)
        if publish and receipt["status"] == "reviewed":
            if head != git(record.root, "rev-parse", "HEAD") or git(record.root, "status", "--porcelain", "--untracked-files=all"):
                raise ValueError("shared source changed during review; candidate retained")
            # Git itself refuses overwrites if an interactive writer dirties a
            # touched path between the check and this fast-forward operation.
            git(record.root, "fetch", "--quiet", str(candidate), receipt["candidate_head"])
            git(record.root, "merge", "--ff-only", receipt["candidate_head"])
            receipt["status"] = "integrated"
        path.write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + "\n")
        path.chmod(0o600)
        record.append("say", actor, {"text": "house-integration-v1 " + json.dumps({
            k: v for k, v in receipt.items() if k != "candidate"}, sort_keys=True)})
        return receipt


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--repo", default=".")
    parser.add_argument("run")
    parser.add_argument("--as", dest="actor", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--publish", action="store_true", help="accept tested candidate by fast-forward")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    try:
        print(json.dumps(integrate(Record(args.repo), args.run, args.actor, publish=args.publish), indent=2))
    except (ValueError, OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as error:
        print(f"integration retained for review: {type(error).__name__}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
